verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a self-hosted Unleash Open Source distribution: you clone the repository and run it in your own environment with Docker Compose, and the community recommends it as an open-source, self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative. However, evidence suggests features such as RBAC, change requests, SSO and SCIM come with paid or hosted tiers, so the 'full platform' is not shown to be in the OSS build. The explicit guarantee that targeting data stays local is documented only for Enterprise Edge. Missing for 10: evidence that the full feature set is available in the open-source distribution, a first-party data-residency statement for the OSS server itself, and hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Run it in our cloud or self-host it on your infrastructure.
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
